description.en: The ID of the cluster to add.

description.zh: 是否添加为仅服务发现。
description.en: Specifies whether to add the cluster for service discovery only.

description.zh: 添加集群时不检查目标集群是否存在istio-system命名空间。一般用于自建Istio迁移ASM场景。
description.en: Specifies whether to skip checking for the \`istio-system\` namespace in the target cluster. This parameter is typically used when you migrate from a self-managed Istio instance to ASM.
The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance.
